blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The No Contact Apprehension Policy (NCAP) returns to five Metro Manila cities on Monday, Oct. 5, restoring camera-based traffic enforcement months after the Supreme Court lifted the temporary restraining order against the system. The policy will be implemented in Manila, Muntinlupa, Parañaque, Quezon City and San Juan. Valenzuela, which had also announced plans to resume NCAP, deferred its implementation due to ongoing roadworks and changing traffic conditions.
